stages.name: Solicitation & RFP Requirements Ingestion
stages.description: Parse Statement of Work (SOW), Section L (Instructions), and Section M (Evaluation Criteria).

stages.name: Compliance & Mandatory Qualifications Matrix
stages.description: Validate contractor capabilities, NAICS certifications, and security clearance requirements.

stages.name: Technical & Past Performance Drafting
stages.description: Structure technical volumes, staffing plans, and past performance project citations.

stages.name: Cost Volume & Rate Card Reconciliation
stages.description: Align labor category hourly billing rates, subcontractor margins, and travel allowances.

stages.name: Red Team & Final Compliance Audit
stages.description: Independent executive peer review verifying all mandatory RFP stipulations are satisfied.

stages.name: Portal Submission & Debrief Archiving
stages.description: Upload to designated procurement portal (PIEE, SAM, or State e-Procurement) with receipt log.
